instructor: Asst. Prof. Dr. Ali Fahim Ni'ma
subject: 04_Advanced_Software_Eng

questions.question: Which one is NOT an object-oriented metric?
questions.question_ar: أي واحد ليس مقياساً كائني التوجه؟
options: RFC
CBO
DAC
OBC
options_en: RFC
CBO
DAC
OBC
questions.explanation: The CK and related suites use RFC, CBO and DAC; OBC is not one of them.
questions.explanation_ar: مجموعة CK وما جاورها تستخدم RFC وCBO وDAC، أما OBC فليس منها.

questions.question: Which metric also counts indirectly connected methods?
questions.question_ar: أي مقياس يعدّ الطرق المتصلة بشكل غير مباشر أيضاً؟
options: none of the above
TCC here again now
LCC now too here
both of the above here
options_en: none of the above
TCC here again now
LCC now too here
both of the above here
questions.explanation: TCC counts direct connections only; LCC adds the indirect ones.
questions.explanation_ar: TCC يعدّ الاتصالات المباشرة فقط، وLCC يضيف غير المباشرة.

questions.question: How is the depth of inheritance tree measured?
options: the number of failure classes
the number of root classes
the number of ancestor classes
the number of successor classes
options_en: the number of failure classes
the number of root classes
the number of ancestor classes
the number of successor classes
questions.explanation: DIT counts how many levels sit above the class in its inheritance chain.
questions.explanation_ar: DIT يعدّ عدد المستويات فوق الصنف في سلسلة وراثته.

questions.question: What does LCOM count in the CK suite?
questions.question_ar: ماذا يعدّ LCOM في مجموعة CK؟
options: the lines that contain comments here again
the depth of inheritance here too now here
the parameters per method now again too now here
method pairs that share no instance variables
options_ar: الأسطر التي تحوي تعليقات الآن هنا أيضاً
عمق الوراثة هنا الآن مجدداً مجدداً
معاملات كل طريقة أيضاً هنا أيضاً الآن
أزواج الطرق التي لا تشترك بمتغيرات نسخة
options_en: the lines that contain comments here again
the depth of inheritance here too now here
the parameters per method now again too now here
method pairs that share no instance variables
questions.explanation: More unshared pairs mean the class is doing unrelated things.
questions.explanation_ar: كثرة الأزواج غير المشتركة تعني أن الصنف يفعل أشياء غير مترابطة.

questions.question: What does WMC measure?
options: the weighted number of methods per class
the number of child classes here here
the coupling between objects too now too
the response set of a class now again
options_en: the weighted number of methods per class
the number of child classes here here
the coupling between objects too now too
the response set of a class now again
questions.explanation: WMC adds the complexity of each method, so a heavy class scores high.
questions.explanation_ar: WMC يجمع تعقيد كل طريقة، فالصنف الثقيل يسجل عالياً.

questions.question: What does NOC count?
options: the callers of a class now again
the immediate subclasses of a class
the methods of a class here here
the attributes of a class too now here
options_ar: صفات الصنف الآن هنا أيضاً الآن
options_en: the callers of a class now again
the immediate subclasses of a class
the methods of a class here here
the attributes of a class too now here
questions.explanation: NOC counts direct children, which shows how far a change could propagate.
questions.explanation_ar: NOC يعدّ الأبناء المباشرين، فيبيّن مدى انتشار التغيير المحتمل.

questions.question: What does CBO measure?
options: the count of basic operations
the class byte offset here too
coupling between object classes
cohesion of a single class now here
options_en: the count of basic operations
the class byte offset here too
coupling between object classes
cohesion of a single class now here
questions.explanation: CBO counts the other classes a given class depends on.
questions.explanation_ar: CBO يعدّ الأصناف الأخرى التي يعتمد عليها صنف معين.

questions.question: What does RFC measure?
options: the reuse factor of code here
the runtime failure count
the reference file count
the response set of a class
options_en: the reuse factor of code here
the runtime failure count
the reference file count
the response set of a class
questions.explanation: RFC counts the methods a class can invoke in response to a message.
questions.explanation_ar: RFC يعدّ الطرق التي يمكن للصنف استدعاؤها استجابةً لرسالة.
